search_text: published ZDI-06-025 ZDI-CAN-055 Mozilla Firefox Javascript navigator Object Vulnerability 2006-07-26 CVE-2006-3677 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-3677 ['Mozilla Firefox'] ['1.5.x'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of the Mozilla Firefox web browser. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The flaw exists when assigning specific values to the window.navigator object.
